entries.2fffcd2a236d34d4: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Recreation Co., Ltd. operates cinema complexes (multiplex cinemas) across Japan, and also runs and undertakes video-related events and provides advertising planning in its directly operated cinemas. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, capturing a strong movie market is cited as one reason operating revenue of the Lifestyle Services Business increased. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.3362168be4c41152: Through its consolidated subsidiary TOKYU PROPERTY MANAGEMENT CO., LTD., the company runs the building management business, which provides property management services for buildings and comprehensive management and operation services such as facility management and cleaning. Its affiliate Tokyu Community Corp. also runs a building management business of the same kind, as well as a condominium management business that provides administrative management and facility management for condominiums. Its affiliate Tokyu REIT, Inc. entrusts asset management operations to Tokyu Real Estate Investment Management Inc. and conducts asset management through that arrangement. Revenue for this segment alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.3dc082790decc09a: Consolidated subsidiary Sendai International Airport Co., Ltd. conducts the airport operation business at Sendai Airport in Miyagi Prefecture, including runway maintenance and the collection of landing fees and other charges. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.54a0e344d4c7828f: Through its affiliate Tokyu Livable, Inc., the company arranges and brokers housing and other properties and provides and arranges related services, through a locally rooted network centered on major cities in the Kanto region. Revenue for this segment alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.6d618c0b8246b6fa: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Store Chain Co., Ltd. handles daily necessities, including food, clothing and household goods, mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.709c04b26d57b3ac: Through its affiliate TOKYU CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD., the company carries out building construction for housing, offices and government buildings, and civil engineering work for roads, railways and land development. Its affiliate Seiki Tokyu Kogyo Co., Ltd. carries out civil engineering work, paving work, waterworks construction and building construction. Revenue for this segment alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.73f777200fb8b311: This is a reportable segment engaged in the hotel and golf businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥138,789 million (¥126,298 million in the previous year), the fourth largest among the reportable segments. Operating revenue including intersegment internal operating revenue was ¥139,346 million (up 9.8% year on year). The increase is attributed to capturing inbound demand, mainly at hotels in central urban areas, and the average room rate at hotels was ¥26,681 (up ¥2,761 year on year). In March 2026, Tokyu Hotels & Resorts Co., Ltd. joined Global Hotel Alliance (GHA), a partnership organization of the world's largest independent hotel brands.
entries.7a357bc80b062255: Five consolidated subsidiaries, including Three Hundred Club Co., Ltd. and Tokyu Seven Hundred Club Co., Ltd., operate golf courses. Revenue for this segment alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.878a4d5b529bc58b: A corporate group engaged in a wide range of businesses, centered on the Tokyu lines' service area: rail and bus transportation, urban development and real estate, department stores and supermarkets, and hotels.
entries.949fc18f99a5bcd7: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Department Store Co., Ltd. operates department stores in Tokyo, Kanagawa Prefecture and Sapporo, Hokkaido, and Nagano Tokyu Department Store Co., Ltd. operates a department store in Nagano Prefecture. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.a47d61e081b3b692: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Railways Co., Ltd. carries passengers on 8 railway lines in southwestern Tokyo and Kanagawa Prefecture, namely the Toyoko Line, Meguro Line, Tokyu Shin-Yokohama Line, Den-en-toshi Line, Oimachi Line, Ikegami Line, Tokyu Tamagawa Line and Kodomo-no-Kuni Line, and on 1 tramway line, the Setagaya Line, in Setagaya-ku, Tokyo, for a total of 9 lines with an operating distance of 110.7 km. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, Tokyu Railways carried 1,117,024 thousand passengers (1,083,879 thousand in the previous year), passenger transportation revenue was ¥152,837 million (¥150,173 million in the previous year), and total revenue including miscellaneous transportation revenue was ¥166,361 million. Among consolidated subsidiaries, Izukyu Corporation carries passengers between Ito and Izukyu-Shimoda on the Izu Peninsula (operating distance 45.7 km), and Ueda Dentetsu Co., Ltd. carries passengers between Ueda and Bessho Onsen in Nagano Prefecture (operating distance 11.6 km). In addition, the railway business was transferred from the company to Tokyu Railways Co., Ltd. through a company split in October 2019.
entries.a6d02c5c5adccee5: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Card Co., Ltd. handles operations related to credit card transactions. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.b75420278b9741bd: Consolidated subsidiary It's Communications Inc. provides cable television and internet connection services over optical fiber and coaxial cable networks laid mainly along the company's lines in Tokyo, Kawasaki and Yokohama. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.b7ee49670184d364: The company leases real estate, including office buildings, mainly along lines in Tokyo and Kanagawa Prefecture, and affiliate Tokyu Land Corporation does so in the Tokyo and Kinki metropolitan areas, regional core cities and elsewhere. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.becbcab034181302: This reportable segment covers real estate sales, real estate leasing and real estate management; in Description of Businesses, real estate brokerage and construction are also listed under this category. The company undertakes land development, sale and leasing of housing construction mainly along lines in Tokyo and Kanagawa Prefecture, and its affiliate Tokyu Land Corporation carries out development, sale and leasing in the Tokyo and Kinki metropolitan areas, among others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥212,736 million (¥204,231 million in the previous year). Operating revenue including inter-segment operating revenue was ¥262,995 million (up 3.6% year on year); the increase is attributed to strong sales at hotels and commercial facilities, which raised rental income, and to property sales in the asset-turnover building business. In Shibuya, construction of Shibuya Scramble Square Phase II (Central Building and West Building) began in May 2025, and in April 2025 the urban redevelopment association for the Miyamasaka District First-Type Urban Redevelopment Project received approval for its establishment.
entries.bfcb76474734ef2b: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Bus Corporation operates route bus services in southwestern Tokyo and Kanagawa Prefecture. In Hokkaido, consolidated subsidiary Jotetsu Co., Ltd. provides passenger transport by route bus and a chartered bus business covering all of Hokkaido. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.c60ef182794a8db9: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Agency Inc. provides agency services for various kinds of advertising. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.d5696b5df1efe077: The company and its consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Hotels Co., Ltd. carry out hotel management and asset management. Its consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Hotels & Resorts Co., Ltd. operates hotels under the brands "Tokyo Hotel", "Excel Hotel Tokyu" and "Tokyu REI Hotel", as well as the "DISTINCTIVE SELECTION" hotel brand group, which features properties with individuality beyond the Tokyu brand framework (directly operated: 37 locations as of March 31, 2026). Tokyu Hotels Co., Ltd. was absorbed by merger into the company on April 1, 2026. In April 2026, "JAM Fukui Katsuyama Tokyu Hotels & Resorts," the first hotel in Fukui Prefecture, opened as a franchised hotel. Revenue for this segment alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.e2af2bf129cbe0e1: Consolidated subsidiary Tokyu Techno System Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures railway rolling stock equipment, undertakes renewal and repair work and periodic inspections, and designs and carries out electrical construction for railway-related facilities. It is not listed among the reportable segment descriptions in Segment Information (railway, bus and airport operation businesses), but appears under the Transportation Business in Description of Businesses. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.ea4b470a275c14bf: This reportable segment covers railway, bus and airport operation businesses; the Railway Rolling Stock-Related Business, which designs, manufactures and repairs railway rolling stock equipment, is also listed under this category in the description of businesses. Tokyu Railways Co., Ltd. carries passengers on 9 lines in total, comprising 8 railway lines and 1 tramway line, in southwestern Tokyo and Kanagawa Prefecture, with an operating distance of 110.7 km. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥223,130 million (¥216,846 million in the previous year), the second largest among reportable segments. Operating revenue including inter-segment operating revenue was ¥226,946 million (up 2.9% year on year); passenger numbers on Tokyu Railways rose above the previous year for both commuter and non-commuter passengers, increasing 3.1% overall.
entries.eb39a88a5e491f98: Consolidated subsidiaries Tokyu Malls Development Co., Ltd. and SHIBUYA109 Entertainment Co., Ltd. operate urban fashion buildings centered on Shibuya and also operate commercial facilities mainly along Tokyu rail lines. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
entries.f07185fa289482ec: The company develops residential land and sells it, sells and undertakes construction of houses and other residential buildings, and also provides real estate consulting services. Affiliate Tokyu Land Corporation develops and sells residential land and builds and sells detached houses, mid- and high-rise housing and holiday homes in the Tokyo and Kinki metropolitan areas and regional core cities, among others, and consolidated subsidiary Becamex Tokyu Co., Ltd. develops and sells residential land and others in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. In March 2026, Becamex Tokyu Co., Ltd. began construction of a new condominium, MIDORI PARK The TENⅡ (14 stories above ground, 374 units in total), in Binh Duong New City, Vietnam. Operating revenue for this category alone is not shown in the securities report.
